newsitem.title: USA: Merrill Lynch files for $200 mln offering.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch files for $200 mln offering.

text.p: Merrill Lynch & Co said Friday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $200 million in trust originated preferred securities.
The trust will be known as Merrill Lynch Preferred Capital Trust I and the sole assets of the Trust will be the Partnership Preferred Securities, the filing said.
All of the proceeds from the sale of the Trust Securities will be invested by the Trust in the Partnerhip Preferred Securities, the filing said.
The partnership will use the funds to make investments in the debentures and certain eligible debt securities, it said.
